newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists get 150 bln lire of Italy 10-yr BTP.
newsitem.headline: Specialists get 150 bln lire of Italy 10-yr BTP.

text.p: Specialist bond traders were allocated 150 billion lire of 10-year fixed-rate bonds (BTP) against bids for 405 billion and the Italian Treasury's offer of 150 billion lire of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 2.344 trillion lire at the open auction for the February 1, 2007 paper, against 1.5 trillion lire worth on offer.
The auction price was set at 94.40 from 97.50 at the previous sale on February 27 and gross yield was 7.69 against 7.22 percent.
